name: Pi-hole
summary: Blocks adverts and trackers for every device on your home network, by answering their DNS lookups

options.label: Web interface password
options.help: For Pi-hole's dashboard and settings (http://<nas-ip>:8053/admin). It can be changed later in Pi-hole (Settings -> Web interface / API).

options.label: Upstream DNS servers
options.help: Where Pi-hole looks up the names it doesn't block. They can be changed later in Pi-hole (Settings -> DNS), including your ISP's or your own.

choices.label: Quad9 (9.9.9.9 - blocks known malicious sites too)
